The '''Makeb Business Council''' was the government of [[Makeb]] prior to its [[Conquest of Makeb|conquest]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in [[3638 BBY]]. It was established by the [[Avesta family]], and was headed by [[Shalim Avesta]] during the conquest. When the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] wanted a presence on Makeb upon hearing of the world's natural resources, the Council forced the Cartel to sign trade partnerships instead.
